name: Returning Home
summary: A summons brings a night elf priest from human lands back to Teldrassil. Brother Joshua carries Priestess Alathea’s call to the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus, where the young priest will receive advanced guidance in Elune’s mysteries.

sections.title: A Summons Across Seas
sections.body: Night elf priests sometimes travel to human lands like Stormwind to share fellowship with the Church of the Holy Light. Their strongest ties remain with the Sisterhood of Elune. Brother Joshua tells you that a night elf emissary has come searching for you. Your early travels are over, and your home temple calls you back for deeper training with High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind’s inner circle.

sections.title: The Temple of the Moon
sections.body: Across the sea, the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus welcomes you home. Priestess Alathea greets you warmly and celebrates your safe passage through a troubled world. Your return brings joy to Alathea and Tyrande. More demanding spiritual trials await.

faq.q: Why is Brother Joshua giving instructions to a night elf priest?
faq.answer: Brother Joshua serves the Church of the Holy Light in human lands, where young Alliance priests often train together. A sister of Elune came to his halls with a message recalling you to Darnassus, and Joshua passes on the summons.

Priestess Alathea is a senior member of the Sisterhood of Elune at the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. She works with High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind and guides the training and advancement of promising night elf priests.

faq.q: What happens after reaching the Temple of the Moon?
faq.answer: At the Temple of the Moon, Priestess Alathea welcomes you home and begins your next rite of passage. Stars of Elune deepens your communion with the Moon Goddess.

faq.q: Can any Alliance race do this quest?
aliases: who can pick up returning home
faq.answer: This summons is for night elf priests who have traveled far from Kalimdor during their early training. It calls you home to study your people’s priesthood traditions with the Sisterhood of Elune.

faq.q: Where is the Temple of the Moon located?
faq.answer: The Temple of the Moon lies in Darnassus’s southern district, atop the boughs of Teldrassil. It is the spiritual heart of night elf culture and High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind’s seat of power.

faq.q: Why does Alathea mention Tyrande Whisperwind?
faq.answer: Tyrande Whisperwind is the High Priestess of Elune and spiritual leader of the night elves. Senior priestesses like Alathea act on her behalf, tracking and guiding novices who represent their faith abroad according to Tyrande’s standards.

angles.text: As a priest, you return from fellowship with the Church of the Holy Light to the Sisterhood of Elune, where you can master Kaldorei rites.
As a night elf priest who has walked among humans or dwarves across the sea, you make a sacred return to Teldrassil’s sanctuaries.
Brother Joshua in the Eastern Kingdoms and the priestesses in Darnassus work together, reflecting the spiritual ties that unite the Alliance.
